pages.title: Purpose
pages.text: The Energy Buffer stores surplus energy for later use. Its default capacity is 200,000 SE, and it distributes up to 800 SE per tick through the cable network.$(br2)Server settings can change both values.

pages.title: Monitoring
pages.text: Connect a power supply and consumers with cables. Right-click to read stored energy and capacity; a comparator reads the charge.$(br2)One buffer offers up to 200 SE per tick to each receiver by default. Use multiple powered sources for higher demand.
